description: Find whole COMMERCIALS (TV / online spots) in FrameThrower's ads library by idea, story or brief ("two rival neighbours outdo each other at Christmas", "a product demo told as a heist") and/or by facts: brand, director, agency, production company, DP, editor, award show and level, year, industry, market, tone, genre, structure, season. Without a query it lists matching spots, award winners first. Returns each spot with brand, title, year, credits, best award, logline, a still and a link to watch it.

award_show.description: One of: Cannes Lions, Clio Awards, D&AD, Epica, AICP Awards, London International Awards, British Arrows, The One Show, El Ojo de Iberoamérica, Eurobest, Creative Circle, Effie Awards, Ciclope, Spikes Asia, ANDY Awards, ADC Awards, DGA Awards, Kinsale Sharks, shots Awards, New York Festivals, Webby Awards, Emmy (Outstanding Commercial), IPA Effectiveness Awards, AdFest, Dubai Lynx, ADC Europe, Young Director Award

awarded.description: true = won or shortlisted at an award show
